basic_info.description: Offer Due 5/7/25, Wednesday at noon.       1109-1113 Montgomery Street is a rare and exceptional 3-unit trophy building with PANORAMIC VIEW of SF skyline and the bay, nestled in the heart of San Francisco's iconic Telegraph Hill. This is a rare chance for investors or 1031 exchange buyers to own a well-maintained, income-producing asset in one of San Francisco's most historically rich and culturally vibrant neighborhoods. (2) 3BD/1BA and (1) 3bd/2ba all updated with excellent natural light. The building's vacant garage comes equipped with laundry and 1+ car parking. This turnkey investment offers a strong rent roll with upside potential, and is perfectly positioned just steps from the vibrant energy of North Beach. With a 99 Walk Score, you are steps to North Beach favorites, including Tony's Pizza, Original Joe's, and dozens of beloved local hotspots. Don't miss your chance to own a piece of San Francisco history with unbeatable location, charm, and income potential.
